title: {Syn} Catalan Conjecture Became Mihailescu Theorem
content:
Catalan conjecture, proved by Preda Mihailescu in 2002, says that 8 and 9 are the only consecutive perfect powers above 0. In symbols, 2^3 and 3^2 are the unique neighboring pair.

It is a compact statement about exponential Diophantine equations, where small examples can hide very deep proof machinery.

Why it matters: number theory keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
